title: mission.mission_started
description: Emitted once per scenario load when the mission state machine transitions from Loaded → InProgress. Carries the mission_id, scenario_id, seed, time limit, and the initial objectives[] roster so replay viewers can reconstruct the mission shape without consulting the scenario manifest. Per M2 spec: 'mission.mission_started fires once with mission_id, seed, scenario_id'.

mission_id.description: M2: mirrors scenario_id (one mission per scenario load). M13+ adds explicit ids when scenarios chain missions.

seed.description: Engine RNG seed for the run.
